action_items: Replace LaunchCampaignPanel.jsx line 299 `<option key={p} value={p}>PHASE · {p}</option>` with a fully-string body so VE instrumentation cannot inject a <span>. e.g.: `<option key={p} value={p}>{p === 'ALL' ? 'PHASE · ALL' : `PHASE · ${p}`}</option>` — mirroring the line-307 platform-option pattern. This eliminates the last span-in-option hydration warning.
critical_code_review_comments: compliance.py is a clean pure-data module (no I/O, no LLM) — endpoints are deterministic and trivially testable. Good separation.
/api/compliance/public correctly projects only {id,label,headline} via list-comprehension — no risk of leaking internal cost/gate notes. Verified in test_does_not_leak_costs_or_gates.
CompliancePanel renders all data via stable testids — excellent for automated regression. Filter state is purely client-side, no server round-trip needed.
Industry card uses ind.gates / ind.tos_must_have / ind.unlock_path / ind.expansion_path conditionally — handles optional fields cleanly.

VE-instrumentation gotcha: any JSX child expression like `{var}` inside an <option> will be wrapped in a span and trigger React hydration warning. Pattern to enforce: option children must be a single string literal (ternary or template literal). Worth documenting for future devs.

server.py is now ~3535 lines (was 3508). Still well past the 700-line guideline. Compliance handler is only 25 lines so the additional impact is minor, but the file split recommendation from iter5 still stands.
